title: Execution and levies prohibited.
bodyText: No execution may issue upon nor may any levy be made against any property of the estate under any judgment against a decedent or a personal representative, but this section shall not be construed to prevent the enforcement of mortgages, pledges or liens upon real or personal property in an appropriate proceeding.
caseNotes: This section prohibits courts from ordering garnishment of an estate's funds to satisfy a judgment against the decedent or the personal representative of the estate that is in probate. 136 H. 365 (App.), 361 P.3d 1268 (2015).

bodyHtml:
§560:3-812  Execution and levies prohibited.  No execution may issue upon nor may any levy be made against any property of the estate under any judgment against a decedent or a personal representative, but this section shall not be construed to prevent the enforcement of mortgages, pledges or liens upon real or personal property in an appropriate proceeding. [L 1996, c 288, pt of §1]

 

Case Notes

 

  This section prohibits courts from ordering garnishment of an estate's funds to satisfy a judgment against the decedent or the personal representative of the estate that is in probate.  136 H. 365 (App.), 361 P.3d 1268 (2015).
